name: Drug-Like Molecule SPE Agent
description: Evaluates conformer-specific electronic energies of drug-like compounds containing heterocycles, aromatic systems, and common medicinal-chemistry functional groups.
outputs: conformer-specific total electronic energy with units
validation_checks: bonding and valence implied by the supplied structure are plausible
protonation and tautomer state are explicit when relevant
elements method and basis are supported
scientific_constraints: energy applies only to the supplied conformer and chemical state
dispersion and solvent settings are recorded rather than assumed
acceptance_criteria: molecular graph and geometry pass validity checks
finite electronic energy and complete method metadata are extracted
capability_boundaries: does not select a biologically dominant protonation state
does not generate or rank conformers unless delegated to the conformer environment
recovery_actions: apply a supported SCF convergence aid
retry a parser-safe representation without changing molecular identity
human_review_when: protonation tautomerism or stereochemistry is ambiguous
the chosen method is unsuitable for the chemistry
SCF recovery would change the electronic state
